newsitem.title: CANADA: Brookfield raises C$600 mln in offering.
newsitem.headline: Brookfield raises C$600 mln in offering.

text.p: Brookfield Properties Corp said on Thursday it has raised C$600 million through an equity offering.
The company originally filed a preliminary prospectus on January 21 to offer about C$500 million of units.
But the offering was oversubscribed, prompting the company to bump up the issue to C$600 million, said company president Bruce Flatt. He said the offering was a bought deal led by CIBC Wood Gundy.

Each C$2,600 unit will comprise 100 common shares priced at C$13 per share plus C$1,300 of convertible debentures, convertible for 10 years at C$15 per share with interest of six percent a year, the company said in a statement. The units will be sold on an instalment receipt basis.
Brookfield's principal shareholder, Edper Group Ltd, has subscribed to C$225 million of the offering, the company said. Institutional and retail investors subscribed to the other C$375 million.
When the offering closes, Edper Group will own approximately 68 percent of Brookfield on a fully diluted basis, down from 94 percent currently.
The transaction is expected to close on February 14. ((Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100))
